description: This file is a PHP source file that implements a database driver using PDO (PHP Data Objects) for the ADOdb library. It contains classes and functions for database connection, query execution, transaction management, and metadata retrieval specifically tailored for PDO-supported databases.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo
classes.description: Main class representing the PDO-based database connection and driver, extends ADOConnection, manages PDO connection, querying, and transaction handling.

classes.name: ADODB_pdo_base
classes.description: Base class for PDO-specific drivers, provides default implementations for meta information and limited functionality.

classes.name: ADOPDOStatement
classes.description: Wraps a PDOStatement object for executing parameterized queries and handling errors.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_pdo
classes.description: Handles recordset of PDO query results, supports fetching fields and rows with different modes.

classes.name: ADORecordSet_array_pdo
classes.description: Specialized recordset class for array-based fetching of PDO results.

methods.name: adodb_pdo_type
methods.description: Converts PDO parameter type integers to string representations for use in queries.

methods.name: _connect
methods.description: Establishes a PDO connection using DSN, username, and password, sets connection attributes, and initializes the driver.

methods.name: Time
methods.description: Returns the current database server timestamp.

methods.name: MetaTables
methods.description: Stub method for metadata of tables, returns false in base class.

methods.name: MetaColumns
methods.description: Stub method for metadata of columns, returns false in base class.

methods.name: SelectLimit
methods.description: Executes a query with limit and offset, handling driver-specific limit implementation.

methods.name: ServerInfo
methods.description: Returns server info, delegates to driver.

methods.name: ErrorMsg
methods.description: Returns latest error message encountered during database operations.

methods.name: ErrorNo
methods.description: Returns latest error number.

methods.name: SetAutoCommit
methods.description: Sets the auto-commit mode.

methods.name: beginTrans
methods.description: Begins a transaction.

methods.name: commitTrans
methods.description: Commits the current transaction.

methods.name: RollbackTrans
methods.description: Rolls back the current transaction.

methods.name: Prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement.

methods.name: PrepareStmt
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement and returns a statement object.

methods.name: createSequence
methods.description: Creates a new sequence object if supported.

methods.name: DropSequence
methods.description: Drops a sequence object if supported.

methods.name: GenID
methods.description: Generates a new sequence ID.

methods.name: _query
methods.description: Executes an SQL query, with parameter binding support.

methods.name: _close
methods.description: Closes the current statement.

methods.name: _affectedrows
methods.description: Returns number of affected rows from the last operation.

methods.name: _insertID
methods.description: Retrieves last insert ID.

methods.name: qStr
methods.description: Quotes a string for safe database insertion.
